nom: PanOxyl Daytime Invisible Patches with Salicylic Acid

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the patches stay put and work well without extra irritation, holding on even when other brands slide off oily skin.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or fragrance-sensitive skin, including one sensitive to adhesive, report no irritation and appreciate the unscented formula.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report the salicylic-acid patches visibly shrink and calm blemishes within hours to a day, working especially well on whiteheads; a few report little to no improvement, and one reviewer says her breakout looked worse after four days of use.
concerns.redness: Many reviewers report a visible drop in redness and swelling around treated spots, often by the next morning.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes the patches help unclog pores and reduce oiliness in addition to calming the blemish.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers report the patches heal blemishes without leaving a dark mark behind.

aspects.libelle: Sticks well, stays on all day
Still visible up close for some

extraits.texte: The sticker was very sticky I will give it that. But it was extremely painful to take off and didn't take out absorb anything anytime I used it. I did not like this product at all.

I was not a huge fan of these patches. I used the larger version on a very irritated break out of mine, and by the fourth day of using them, it appeared to have made my breakout worse. Each time I've worn one, no one was able to even notice I had one on, so that was a plus. They adhere to the skin well, without budging. I just wish they worked better for me.

I have extremely oily skin, which makes some pimple patches not stay on overnight or even during the day. These however do stay on my oily skin and they suck out all of the gunk. I would recommend these to anyone.

I've been loving the PanOxyl Daytime Invisible Patches with Salicylic Acid! These patches are an absolute game changer for occasional blemishes, especially during perimenopause when my skin tends to act up unpredictably. They're super effective, I notice a visible reduction in redness and size within a day of use. The texture is smooth and light, and they blend seamlessly into the skin, making them perfect for wearing out during the day without feeling self conscious. The packaging is compact and hygienic, making it easy to toss into my bag for on the go use. There's no noticeable scent, which I appreciate since I'm sensitive to fragrances. Overall, I think these patches offer great value for the results they deliver!

extraits.titre: Effective and delicate, perfect for sensitive skins
extraits.texte: I've suffered from acne since I was a teenager. While my dermatologist helped me improve it a lot, I still get the occasional breakout. In those cases, this patch is perfect. First of all, it's practically invisible, I actually forgot I was wearing it. It's super comfortable, and it doesn't hurt at all when you take it off. You can really tell it's made of high-quality materials and is suitable for sensitive skin like mine. 1000/10

I love theses pimple patches! They stick really well to the skin. They remove the pimple almost everytime useless it's a real stubborn pimple. I love the different sizes. I don't ever have any skin irritation when I use it on my oily skin! I highly recommend
